$Comment: The Fire Resistance Potion (Item/Items/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Fire_Resistance_Potion.json): drunk, it takes 35% off Fire damage for three minutes, for a player heading into the Headless Horseman's graveyard. Requires opens it once Old Jack counts the player Trusted, which the gate spells Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack/Honored (Old Jack's ranks keep the library's ids under the names Reputations/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.json gives them); a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line, so a player can see what to work towards, and the graveyard's clear pays potions to everyone. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 5 puts it first on the gear shelf, ahead of the Jack Helm (10). Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets; the reward's Count is how many potions each purchase hands over. Named by the item's own keys.
